policy: The master branch is the current end-user artifact set; no separate public package version is assigned or displayed.

upgrade_handshake.why: Legacy clients (<= 3.4.10-h5) decide upgrades by semantic version only and refuse to install a script whose readonly VERSION is missing; this constant is therefore an upgrade handshake token, not a public release number. It must stay monotonic and match ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)*(-h[0-9]+)?$.
upgrade_handshake.anti_downgrade: This build also refuses to install a remote artifact whose VERSION is lower than the local one (release rollback / mirror lag / accidental stale push).

note: The files map covers README.md, USAGE.md, SHA256SUMS, and vless-server.sh. PROVENANCE.json is excluded from its own hash map to avoid recursive hashing.
